BCCI clarifies Rohit Sharma's future amid retirement speculation

Amidst speculation surrounding Indian cricketer Rohit Sharma's future in 50-over cricket, the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has issued a clarification. Reports suggest that the Lord's ODI will not be his last match. This comes as Sharma, aged 39, performed well in a recent match, with his wife also present at the venue.
